asset.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original editorial cover illustration for PolicyEngine's UK Autumn Budget 2026 article on savings and property income tax.
Create a polished wide 16:9 landscape illustration, intended final size 1600x900. Match a coherent nonprofit policy research illustration series: deep dark teal background, soft subtle teal vignette, pale mint and turquoise objects, clean vector-like shapes rendered as a raster image, restrained dimensional depth, gentle shadows, crisp edges, professional calm neutral tone.
Scene: a simplified British terraced house and a savings coin stack arranged together beside a large white income-tax statement with a teal header and a few muted grey abstract lines. One mint coin bears a clear British pound symbol (£). House, savings and statement should read as one coherent still life about taxing rental income and savings interest.
Composition: main objects within the central 65 percent of the canvas, clear at thumbnail size, generous breathing room on every edge, balanced wide layout, a subtle floor line. Avoid tiny details.
Text: only a single £ symbol on the coin; no words, no tax rates, no numbers, no labels, no title, no logos, no watermark.
Constraints: original illustration, no people, no flags, no political symbolism, no arrows or data charts, no claims about gains or losses. The image should look like a refined flat editorial illustration with subtle depth, not a photograph or a glossy toy render.
asset.reuse_note: Unchanged copy of the illustration also retained under the property article's asset path. The original illustration was generated for the combined savings/property draft; this reuse introduces no new generated image or data in the image.
